newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to absorb one trln won through repos.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to absorb one trln won through repos.

text.p: The Bank of Korea said on Wednesday it has decided to absorb one trillion won from commercial banks through six-day repurchase agreements (repos).
"We have decided to siphon off one trillion won through six-day repos because of excess liquidity in the market following central bank dollar buying intervention," a central bank official said.
"Despite the squeeze, liquidity would remain high until the end of this month," he said.
